title: Porting my 1993 Amiga game to Godot, with an LLM reading the 68000 assembly
summary: A developer recounts porting their 1993 Amiga game (originally written in MC68000 assembly in Baghdad) to Godot 4 using Claude, which accomplished the initial port in one evening. The developer then spent weeks analyzing the AI's work, supplementing it with 33 years of memory about the original implementation, and collaborated with the AI to write the article over a week of editing.
problem_solved: Converting decades-old assembly language code into a modern cross-platform game engine while preserving game logic and feel
why_valuable: Demonstrates the emerging capability of LLMs to understand, interpret, and translate legacy assembly code—a task that traditionally required deep domain expertise and extensive manual effort
